description: Fires when I must block an opponent's immediate win in column 1 (second from left). Strongest when they have three stacked vertically in column 1 with the cell above empty; moderate for a horizontal or diagonal threat at column 1's landing cell in rows 2-4. Does not fire for a bottom-row threat there, vertical threes in other columns, when I have an immediate win, or when facing a double threat.
effect: Pushes the model toward playing column 1: forcing it to max raises column 1 by about 45-60 points of probability in positions that would otherwise play elsewhere; zeroing it changes nothing when the block is already chosen (redundant with other circuitry).
notes: Best dev F1 0.604 (precision 0.88, recall 0.46, AUROC 0.73) with p4. Minimal pairs: vertical three col1 21.9 vs col0 0.8, col2 3.7, cols3-6 ~0.1; blocked -> -0.1; my own three -> 0.25; row-0 horizontal threat at (0,1) ~0.1 but row-1 threat at (1,1) 6-8; double threat suppresses. Tried adding non-playable col-1 threats, opponent forks via col 1, and col 0/2 must-blocks: all lowered F1. About half the firing is diffuse near-threshold activity around threats in/near column 1 that the program misses. Simulation share reported nan.
